name: study2_cohort
title: Emergency Department Visits with Diagnosis of Heart Failure
description: This cohort includes adult patients visiting the Emergency Department (whether or not the visit led to a hospital admission) with a heart failure diagnosis, either coded on the Emergency Department encounter itself or registered within the 2 days before or the 2 days after the end of the visit (e.g. HF coded only at the hospital stay that followed the visit). The reference time point is the end of the Emergency Department visit.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

entry.name: patientEmergencyEncounter
entry.description: Captures ambulatory visits/encounters to the Emergency Department.

period.description: Includes all encounters for the defined cohort population.

eligibility.name: adultsWithHeartFailureAtEdVisit
eligibility.description: Adult patients with a heart failure diagnosis coded on the Emergency Department encounter.

criteria.description: Adult patients with a heart failure diagnosis coded on the Emergency Department encounter.

eligibility.name: adultsWithHeartFailureAroundEdVisit
eligibility.description: Adult patients with a heart failure diagnosis registered within the 2 days before or the 2 days after the end of the Emergency Department visit.

criteria.description: Adult patients with a heart failure diagnosis registered within the 2 days before or the 2 days after the end of the Emergency Department visit.
